description: Everything linked to one commit: subject, author and date with its sha, the mail thread its Discussion: link names (participants resolved to people and organizations), the commitfest entry if tracked, and Discord mentions. For postgres also first_releases (per branch the change landed on: branch, sha, release e.g. 14.23 or null when unreleased, first_version incl. betas, shipped=false when it was reverted before that release), reverted_by (the commits that revert it, each with its own reverted_by) and reverts, read from git tags and commit messages, never guessed. commit_id takes a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N or a commit_id from another tool; repository defaults to postgres. The diff itself is not included (git_diff, or git_show_file for one file). Cite the sha and the thread's https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

commit_id.description: The commit: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io).

name: commit_history
